claim: 31 U.S.C. s.714(b) excludes from GAO audit: transactions with foreign central banks, governments and nonprivate international financing organizations; deliberations, decisions or actions on monetary policy including discount-window operations, member-bank reserves, securities credit, interest on deposits and open-market operations; transactions directed by the FOMC; and related internal communications.

notes.ceiling: THIS IS THE STRONGEST DOCUMENTED ACCOUNTABILITY GAP IN THE DOMAIN AND IT IS A DELIBERATE LEGISLATIVE CHOICE, NOT A CONCEALMENT. Named actor: Congress. Named instrument: s.714(b). Named date: 1978, unrepealed 2026.
